UK residents. Ts&Cs apply.

sections.label: Get the most out of Monzo
text: Get the most out of Monzo
Whatever stage of life you're at, we've got your money covered.
Current accounts
From joint accounts and accounts for kids, to accounts with worldwide travel insurance – choose one that works for you.
Savings
Grow your money in Monzo with up to 3.65% AER interest (variable), paid monthly.
Credit
Get a credit card with Monzo magic. Whether you're new to credit or a seasoned pro, there's something to suit you. Age 18+.
Investments
Choose from a range of options to suit your interests and the level of risk you’re happy with. Starting with as little as £1.
Pensions
Track down and bring your old pensions together under one roof, and top up whenever you like. Ages 18-70.
Homeownership
Connect a mortgage from any lender in 60 seconds. And get insights that could save you thousands.
UK residents. Individual product Ts&Cs apply.
The value of investments and pensions could go up or down, and you could get back less than you invest.
UK current account needed for: investments, pensions, savings accounts, mortgage tool, and Flex. Flex eligibility criteria applies. Missed payments may negatively impact credit scores.

sections.label: Quit the app juggling act
text: Quit the app juggling act
From everyday spending to bigger goals, it's the one app to fit your finances.
Go to slide 1
Go to slide 2
Go to slide 3
Go to slide 4
Go to slide 5
Sort your salary
Use Salary Sorter to divide up your income or student loan into separate Pots for bills, spending and whatever else you need to budget for. Set it up once, and we’ll take it from there.
Put bills in their place
You don’t enjoy paying bills, but we enjoy making it easier. Set up Direct Debits and standing orders to come directly from a dedicated bills Pot.
Round up your spare change
Want to save without even thinking about it? Automatically send spare change to your savings every time you spend.
Earn cashback on brands you love
Pick your offers, shop in person or online, and earn 2-10% cashback every time. It’s that simple.
Invest automatically
Auto invest features help you set investing habits and let them tick along in the background. You can also automatically invest any interest you earn on your savings each month.
The value of your investments could go up or down and you could get back less than you put in. 18+, Monzo current account required.

sections.label: The bank made for travel
text: The bank made for travel
No foreign transaction fees or added costs – so travel feels lighter from the start.
Fee-free spending abroad
Pay anywhere, in any currency – on your debit or credit card – with no foreign transaction fees.
Live exchange rates
As soon as you pay, we’ll show you the amount in pounds in the app. No waiting, no guessing, and no more napkin maths.
No surprises at checkout
See the price of things before you go with our currency converter.
Card freeze
Freeze and unfreeze your card at any time if it goes exploring without you.
Multi-trip travel cover
Get multi-trip insurance with Max. From £19 a month. Ages 18-69. UK residents. 3 month minimum term. Ts&Cs apply.

sections.label: Save like a superhero
text: Save like a superhero
Keep your money at your fingertips in personalised Savings Pots, or earn tax-free interest with an ISA.
Instant Access Savings
The most flexible way to save. Earn from 2.75% to 3.25% AER interest (variable) paid monthly, depending on your subscription plan.
Select Access Savings
Grow your money faster without locking it away and get a higher rate for making 2 (or fewer) withdrawals a year. Earn up to 3.65% AER interest (variable), paid monthly. £500 minimum deposit.
ISAs
Earn tax-free on your savings and investments with a Monzo ISA. The taxes you pay depend on your circumstances and could change in the future.

sections.label: Make payday twice as nice
text: Make payday twice as nice

Get paid into Monzo through Bacs and get your salary one business day early.You could also land a Double Payday. It works like this: if you earn £1,500, we'll add an extra £1,500 to your account. It’s yours to spend, save or invest – and you won’t pay tax on your winnings. There are 10 lucky custome
UK residents. 18+. Eligibility based on previous month’s salary. Current Account and Double Payday Ts&Cs apply.

sections.label: A regulated bank with 24/7 support
text: A regulated bank with 24/7 support
24/7 support
You can speak to us through our in-app chat – whenever, wherever. We're here for you 24/7.
Deposit cash and cheques
Add cash to your account at any PayPoint or Post Office (£1 per deposit), and pay in cheques via the app.
No hidden fees
Our current accounts are free and we don’t charge monthly fees or surprise you with hidden costs.
FSCS protected
Your eligible money in Monzo is protected by the FSCS up to £120,000 per person.
